Then, you can use it to generate speech, stories, even full audiobooks, and in that exact voice across over 600 languages. Plus, you also get controls to fine-tune the gender, age, accent, pitch, and even emotions. It also has a built-in MCP server so your Claude Code can use it directly. Want to try this for yourselves? Just comment "Voice" down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
